concerns.text: The core research question (whether a GNN outperforms a descriptor‑based RF on experimental permeability) cannot be answered because **no verified open dataset contains experimental permeability measurements** (see Research section stating “No verified source contains experimental permeability measurements”). The plan simply aborts the pipeline if the target column is missing, leaving FR‑001 unmet and rendering all downstream success criteria (SC‑001 – SC‑005) unattainable. Without acquiring a suitable permeability dataset, the study is untestable.

The planned Spearman rank‑correlation between the SHAP descriptor ranking (RF) and the GNNExplainer substructure ranking (GNN) compares two fundamentally different feature spaces (global molecular descriptors vs. local substructures). This metric lacks a clear scientific interpretation and may not meaningfully assess interpretability agreement.
